name: Gw Luxemburg
author: ElEcmEtAl
description: Go between the cube portal and spikes as the ship at 15.8%. Navigate through the gameplay as the ship until 24% where you can fall to the floor. Stay slightly above the spikes on the floor from 31%-40% until you can fall back to the floor. Fly slightly up at 73% while staying under the platform but above the floor spikes. Stay near the floor while being above the spikes until 80% where you can hold to the ceiling between the structure and yellow orb. Fall back into the level at 82%, shortly after the ship portal. Play the level normally from there.
